# Support

For local setup questions, start with [Setup and Bootstrap](../docs/SETUP.md), then check the [Architecture](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and [Testing Strategy](../docs/TESTING_STRATEGY.md).

For a reproducible software defect, use the [bug report form](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml). For a proposed capability, use the [feature request form](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml) and describe any CUT ICT decision the capability depends on.

Do not post passwords, API keys, real student/staff records, ticket descriptions, or production configuration in issues. Suspected security vulnerabilities must follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) rather than a public issue.
